I'll start before the rush takes over.
Isla spots her morning errands waiting, but steals one kept moment for the grid first.

No need to chase the clock.
As the train slips off schedule, she uses the kept journey as a moving pocket of focus.

Three whole minutes, just for this.
At a busy street table, Isla ignores her inbox and claims three minutes of peace instead.

Today has its own little rule-set — check the constraint before rushing.
